items.title: Autonomous Enterprise Customer Support Agent
items.meta: B.Tech CSE Final Year (6 Months Track)
items.text: A multi-agent customer intelligence system that parses complex queries, queries a vectorized knowledge base (RAG), and autonomously executes refunds or ticket escalations through REST APIs.
items.metric: Sub-second response time, 94% semantic query accuracy over 10,000 corporate documents.

items.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS B2B Invoicing & Analytics Platform
items.text: Complete SaaS invoicing ecosystem featuring workspace isolation, automated GST-compliant invoice generation, Stripe billing subscriptions, and real-time revenue analytics dashboards.
items.metric: Supports 50+ concurrent corporate tenants with sub-100ms API response latency.

items.title: Predictive Retail Sales & Inventory Optimization Engine
items.text: A machine learning pipeline forecasting inventory stockout risks and seasonal sales trends across 25 retail branches, integrated with interactive Power BI executive dashboards.
items.metric: Reduced inventory forecasting error (RMSE) by 28% compared to historical baseline.

items.title: Vulnerability Assessment & Automated SOC Alert Pipeline
items.meta: Diploma to Degree (6 Months Industrial Training)
items.text: Simulated enterprise network penetration audit identifying OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, unauthorized privilege escalation vectors, and integrating automated Wazuh SIEM rule alerts.
items.metric: Remediated 14 critical CVE vulnerabilities with documented zero-trust network policies.

items.title: Electric Vehicle Transmission Geartrain Parametric Model
items.text: High-precision 3D parametric assembly of a single-speed EV reduction gearbox, complete with stress simulation, thermal analysis, and ISO-standard production drafting sheets.
items.metric: Exceeded structural safety factor standards under 300 Nm torque loading.

items.title: Full-Stack EdTech Learning Management System (LMS)
items.text: Responsive video course portal with student lecture progress tracking, automated quiz assessments, video streaming CDN integration, and instant Razorpay fee checkouts.
items.metric: Successfully handled 500+ active student video streaming sessions in stress testing.
